description: Land Acquisition - Kudalunuka, Rideemaliyadda D/S Division, Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the acquisition of land for the Morana tank Project. It includes descriptions of specific land parcels, their locations, extents, and claimant information. The content focuses exclusively on land matters without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette (Type 4).
